name: s1_small
prompt: Comic book illustration, clean ink and cel shading. A lone warrior on a bare hilltop at dusk raises ONE steel sword across the sky, only one sword in frame, plain warm uncluttered background. Along ONE SHORT stretch of the blade, on the metal inside its outline, runs a row of SMALL pale-cyan dots, each about the width of the blade's edge bevel, WIDELY SPACED far apart. The dots have NO black outline and NO ink border of any kind — they are soft flat spots of pale colour printed directly on the steel, unlined, like faint pigment. The rest of the weapon is plain steel. Nothing else in the picture is cyan or blue.
